subject.title: fix(discord): default account env fallback when accounts.default.token is blank

question: Should a blank `channels.discord.accounts.default.token` remain an explicit opt-out, or should the default account fall through to top-level/env fallback across all Discord credential surfaces?
rationale: This PR changes compatibility-sensitive credential fallback behavior, and the repository policy treats config/default fallback changes as maintainer-visible merge risk rather than a purely mechanical test update.

options.title: Adopt fallback across surfaces
options.body: Update resolver, account inspection, setup inspection, and tests so blank default-account tokens consistently fall through to top-level/env fallback while non-default blank tokens remain opt-out.

options.title: Keep blank as opt-out
options.body: Close or rewrite this PR because the existing explicit-blank behavior is the intended compatibility contract even for the default account.

options.title: Accept resolver-only behavior
options.body: Merge the runtime mitigation as-is and knowingly accept temporary setup/status disagreement until a follow-up fixes inspection surfaces.

recommendation.title: Adopt fallback across surfaces
recommendation.body: Update resolver, account inspection, setup inspection, and tests so blank default-account tokens consistently fall through to top-level/env fallback while non-default blank tokens remain opt-out.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent shared Discord token inspection work is the central sibling surface that needs to move with the resolver decision.
